fields.subject: Grain Persistence
fields.condition: a query contract is configured for the supplied grain type
fields.response: map the configured read query's result into the supplied state, or into a new default TModel instance when the supplied state is null, using result-set mapping (with collections when TModel has collection map properties) or output-parameter mapping according to the query contract's result format, and keep the mapped result on every branch; when the mapping returns no result (null), create the state with TModel's static IActivator<TModel> factory when TModel implements IActivator<TModel>, otherwise as a default TModel instance whose key values are set from the grain id
fields.postcondition: when the read returned a record, State is the mapped result and RecordExists is true; when it returned none, State is the newly activated instance and RecordExists is false
